strings.home.intro: Logic blocks linked together: data go along the links and each block does something with them. A project groups schemas and windows; the engine runs it in lilOS.

strings.map.noObjects: {n} components · no object in the schemas

strings.options.title: Project options
strings.options.name: Name
strings.options.windowsHint: lilOS opens the windows of the project. The main window is required: it opens from the apps menu.
strings.options.noWindows: The project has no windows yet.
strings.options.mainHint: It can be changed, never removed.
strings.options.unlinkedHint: A window with no entry point opens only from another window of the app (a button with «Open a window»).
strings.options.removeHint: Removing a console, its blocks write to the main one.
strings.outside.all.hint: each console opens in a window when the project starts
strings.outside.onInput: Only when they ask for something
strings.outside.onInput.hint: a console opens when a Leggi da console block waits
strings.outside.hidden.hint: lines go to the log, questions get their default value
strings.outside.main.hint: one window, each line with the name of its console
strings.options.closeAfter: Close the console after the answer
strings.options.notify: A notification when a console asks for something and the project has no windows open
strings.options.copyToLog: Copy to the log of the project
strings.options.mainOpens: With «All in the main console», the main one opens
strings.options.consoleQuota: Lines kept in memory count in your memory quota; lines copied to the log count in your log quota.
strings.options.appHint: What the windows of the project share while it runs: also in the app made from it.
strings.options.keepValues: A window opened again shows the last values at once
strings.options.keepValuesHint: The engine keeps the last value sent to each component.
strings.options.syncCopies: Copies of the same window stay in step
strings.options.syncCopiesHint: The same window open on two devices shows the same values; a change on one shows on the other.
strings.options.commandsHint: Buttons, switches and sliders send something only when someone uses them in an open window: nothing is pressed again when a window opens.
strings.window.soon: The editor of windows comes with the package of UI components.
strings.window.title: Title
strings.window.hint: Add components from the palette on the left: a click puts it into the container selected, dragging puts it where the blue line shows.
strings.window.missing: This component ({type}) comes from a package that is not installed.

strings.window.noObject: No schema has its object yet: without it the component shows and does nothing.
strings.window.removeObject: Its object in the schema «{schema}» stays there and shows an error until you remove it too.
strings.action.hint: It also sends «pressed» to its object in the schema.
